// Request: A comprehensive fullstack Workout & Fitness Tracker application featuring Express API endpoints, Prisma ORM database models for exercises and workout logs, and a responsive dark-mode React dashboard. It includes interactive workout logging with live timer and set tracking, weekly progress charts, personal record detection and badge displays, exercise library management, and historical workout analytics.

INFERRED FEATURE SPECIFICATIONS (implement ALL of these):
- Interactive Workout Logger: Allows users to start a workout session, add exercises, log sets with weight and reps, use a rest timer, and save the completed workout. [lucide-react, date-fns] (User inputs workout data → React state tracks active session & timer → Express API validates and saves via Prisma → Database stores WorkoutLog and WorkoutSet records)
- Weekly Progress Analytics Dashboard: Visualizes workout frequency, total volume lifted, and muscle group distribution over time using interactive charts. [recharts, lucide-react] (Express queries historical logs via Prisma → Aggregates weekly volume and frequency metrics → Recharts renders responsive dark-mode SVG charts)
- Personal Record (PR) Badge System: Automatically detects when a user lifts a heavier weight or performs more reps than previous logs, awarding PR badges. [lucide-react, canvas-confetti] (New set submitted → Backend compares against historical exercise maxes → If surpassed, PR flag is set and celebratory badge is rendered with confetti animation)
- Exercise Library & Management: Browse, search, and filter a comprehensive list of exercises categorized by muscle group and equipment, with options to create custom exercises. [lucide-react, @tanstack/react-table] (User searches/filters → Frontend queries Express API → Prisma filters Exercise model → Filtered list rendered with loading skeletons and empty states)
- Workout History & Log Management: View past completed workouts in a chronological list or calendar view, with options to view details, edit, or delete logs. [date-fns, lucide-react] (User navigates to history → Express fetches paginated workout logs → Frontend renders timeline with expandable set details and delete/edit side effects)

Required libraries: express, @prisma/client, react, lucide-react, recharts, date-fns, canvas-confetti, @tanstack/react-table, cors, dotenv

Feature folders: dashboard, logger, exercises, history, analytics, components, prisma, routes

Each feature listed above is REQUIRED. Do not omit any of them.
Implement every data flow end-to-end. No mocked data. No placeholder UI.


DESIGN SYSTEM — MANDATORY USAGE:
A design system has been pre-generated at src/design-system/.
You MUST import reusable components from there:
  import { Button, Skeleton, EmptyState } from '../design-system/index.js';

Design Language for this project: elegant (inspired by Linear/Vercel/Stripe)
Color palette: blue brand + slate neutral
Spacing: 8px grid (multiples of 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16...)
Border radius: md (consistent across ALL components)
Font: Inter

FORBIDDEN UI PATTERNS:
  ✗ Different border radii on different components (e.g. some rounded-2xl, some rounded-lg)
  ✗ Arbitrary gradient backgrounds not matching the brand palette
  ✗ Buttons larger than 56px height
  ✗ More than 4 different font sizes in a single view
  ✗ Inconsistent spacing that breaks the 8px grid
  ✗ Excessive glassmorphism (max 1 blur panel per page)
  ✗ Missing hover/focus/active states on ANY interactive element
  ✗ Icon-only buttons without aria-label
  ✗ No visible focus indicator (outline-none without focus-visible replacement)

REQUIRED UI PATTERNS:
  ✓ Every interactive element has hover + focus-visible state
  ✓ Destructive actions show a confirmation step before executing
  ✓ Every async operation has a loading skeleton (not just a spinner)
  ✓ Every data-absent state has an EmptyState component with a call-to-action
  ✓ Error states show the actual error message + a recovery action
  ✓ All inputs have labels (visible or aria-label)
  ✓ Responsive at sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px) breakpoints
